Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.fluid

Class SBFluidLogic

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.fluid.SBFluidLogic
public final class SBFluidLogic extends Object
Loader-neutral coordination of Source Bucket assignment and infinite output after SBItem selects a gesture. Sided block storage, vanilla water/lava cauldron transitions, arbitrary world placement, and per-fluid sounds are loader primitives on BucketOperations; this class enforces the SBPolicy allowlist and the assignment, matching-intake, and output policy.

    • tryTakeWithContext

      public static boolean tryTakeWithContext(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult hit, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, ProtectionContext context)
      Tries to assign an empty Source Bucket or sink matching fluid using explicit authorization.

      A sided block store has priority, followed by supported cauldrons and the world block's pickup contract. Every acquired content is allowlist-checked and the exact target is protected before mutation. An empty bucket records the acquired identity; an assigned bucket accepts only matching input and retains its identity.

      Returns:
      true for an accepted client prediction or completed server intake

    • tryPlace

      public static boolean tryPlace(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult hit, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, ProtectionContext context, boolean allowFaceOffset)
      Tries infinite output from an assigned Source Bucket with explicit authorization identity.

      A sided store has priority; a present non-cauldron store that refuses is authoritative and blocks world fall-through. A cauldron is served by BucketOperations.cauldronPlace(net.minecraft.world.level.Level, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos, net.minecraft.core.Direction, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack, net.minecraft.world.level.material.Fluid, com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.protection.ProtectionContext). Otherwise the loader's arbitrary-fluid world placement runs. The bucket is never debited.

      Returns:
      true for an accepted client prediction or a completed server transaction
